name: 市税の公示送達方法を見直す
summary: これまでは、市税の公示送達を掲示場への掲示で行っていました。この議案では、公示する内容を不特定多数が閲覧できる状態にする措置を加え、掲示場への掲示のほか、市の事務所に設置した電子計算機の画面で閲覧できるようにする方法も設けます。
changes: 公示事項を不特定多数が閲覧できる状態にする措置を加える
公示事項を掲示場に掲示する方法に加え、市の事務所の電子計算機の画面で閲覧できる状態にする方法を設ける
who: 市税の公示送達の対象となる人
why: 地方税法等の一部改正法の施行に伴い、規定を整える必要があるためと、市は説明しています。

en.name: Revises how notices of service for city taxes are made public
en.official: Ordinance Partially Amending the Higashikurume City Tax Ordinance
en.summary: Until now, service of city tax documents by public notice was carried out by posting notices on notice boards. This bill adds measures to make the matters being announced publicly available for viewing by an unspecified number of people. In addition to posting them on notice boards, it establishes a method for making them viewable on computer screens installed at city offices.
changes: Adds measures to make the matters being announced publicly available for viewing by an unspecified number of people
Adds a method of making the matters being announced publicly viewable on computer screens at city offices, in addition to posting them on notice boards
who: People subject to service by public notice for city taxes
en.why: The city says the provisions need to be adjusted following the entry into force of the law partially amending the Local Tax Act and other laws.
